thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue depth on prod-inference (>90% queued). Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. Severity P1.

alice (oncall): seeing big spike in the inference queue, customers hitting 429s. Investigating autoscaler errors now.

bob (sre): I can see the HPA/queue metrics. Queue growth started ~1938762000. Autoscaler logs show failures when creating nodegroup: 
```
E0905 12:07:41 autoscaler.go:312] failed to create nodegroup: LaunchTemplateVersionNotFound: The specified launch template version does not exist.
\tstatus code: 400, request id: abc-123
```

kumar (eng-runtime): that explains it — we recently updated the GPU node launch template to v5 but the autoscaler config references v3 for the new pool. New instances are rejected by ASG. Also seeing IAM profile not attached error for bootstrap on previous attempts.

jane (product-ops): any impact on customer-facing SLAs? CS already getting tickets. @max can you triage which customers are affected?

max (cs): two large customers reported increased latency and some 429s starting ~30m ago. Will open support tickets and add to status page if outage prolonged.

alice (oncall): immediate plan: 1) try manual ASG scale up for a compatible nodegroup; 2) if that fails, fallback route: switch traffic to lower-capacity model variant to reduce GPU pressure. Doing manual scale now.

bob (sre): attaching relevant kubectl outputs: 
```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
(No new GPU nodes provisioned since 1938762100)

$ kubectl describe nodegroup prod-gpu-pool
Taints:
  nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule
LaunchTemplate: prod-gpu-lt (version: 3)
```

kumar (eng-runtime): Confirmed: launch template in ASG is v3, current required is v5 (new AMI and instance profile). Autoscaler is attempting to create instances with v3 and AWS rejects. Also discovered the instance profile attached to v5 has the required SSM and KMS perms; v3 profile lacks them and bootstrap fails.

alice (oncall): manual ASG scale up attempted -> failed with same LT error. Creating emergency ASG override to point to prod-gpu-lt:v5 and initiating scale. Leaving a note in runbook.

bob (sre): while Alice updates ASG, I'm going to enable the autoscaler's fallback policy to allow creation of smaller GPU instances (g4dn) if p4 nodes can't be provisioned. This should reduce queue growth.

pagerduty-bot: Incident severity set to P1, paging escalation to on-call team.

jane (product-ops): notify marketing/ops for status page and do a short blurb: "Experiencing capacity-related throttling for model endpoints in prod-inference; working on restore."

max (cs): customers A & B notified. Asked for ETA and mitigation steps.

kumar (eng-runtime): logs from ASG update attempt: 
```
Updating AutoScalingGroup prod-gpu-asg -> LaunchTemplate prod-gpu-lt:v5
Status: UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS
Event: Launch template updated, starting instance launches
Event: Instance i-0abc123 failed to bootstrap: InstanceProfileMissing
```

alice (oncall): hmm InstanceProfileMissing — looks like v5 references an instance profile name that isn't attached in this account/region due to a terraform drift. Can someone with IAM perms confirm?

bob (sre): I can attach a temp instance profile with required perms so the bootstraps succeed. Doing that now via console (quick fix).

(5m pass)

bob (sre): attached temporary instance profile and retriggered launch. New GPU node came up: node-ixx-02 marked Ready.

alice (oncall): great — kube-scheduler started binding pods, queue drain started. Observed 40% drop in queued items already.

max (cs): customers report fewer 429s now. Still some elevated latency for heavy requests; they've acknowledged the mitigation.

kumar (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a proper IaC change: ensure launch template v5 is the one referenced by autoscaler config and terraform has the instance profile resource. Also we'll add a validation to CI to prevent LT version drift.

jane (product-ops): recommend enabling burst capacity policy for Dedicated customers in the short term — reduces user impact while infra fixes are applied.

alice (oncall): status update for Slack/ops channel drafted. Will escalate to postmortem owner.

ivy (oncall-next): taking handoff in 30m. Please summarize actions and outstanding tasks.

alice (oncall): tl;dr: root cause = launch template/version mismatch + missing instance profile causing bootstrap to fail; symptom = autoscaler unable to provision GPU nodes -> queued inference requests and customer 429s. Mitigations performed: temporary instance profile attached, ASG launch template updated to v5, manual scale triggered, autoscaler fallback for smaller GPUs enabled, traffic shifted to lower-capacity model for particularly affected endpoints.

alice (oncall): outstanding: 1) revert temp IAM changes to terraform-managed resource, 2) permanent autoscaler config update, 3) postmortem + customer incident note, 4) add CI validation for LT/version drift. Assigning postmortem to kumar + bob.

kumar (eng-runtime): will own IaC fixes and CI check.

bob (sre): will own postmortem writeup and quantify customer impact.

max (cs): I'll coordinate customer comms and summarize affected tenants for legal/SE.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by on-call: alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): closing on-call actions for now, monitoring for next 45m, handing to ivy afterwards. :thumbsup:
